findings.finding: The class now reaches only the named components in their decided kinds, and only through a pinned upstream binary. But it does not tie each component to the license it was decided under, or to the binary it was decided in. Any of the four class terms is accepted for any of the six named components. Any static component qualifies when linked into any of containerd, pause and runc. The owner decided specific pairs. Q-L: glibc LGPL-2.1-or-later (static in containerd, runc and pause, per W03-0 D-LIC-GLIBC) and libseccomp LGPL-2.1-only (static in runc only, D-LIC-LIBSECCOMP). Q-L2: GCC runtime under GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1 (static in containerd, runc and pause), libnftnl GPL-2.0-or-later and libmnl LGPL-2.1-or-later as host shared libraries of nft. Probes: {glibc, STATIC_SYSTEM_LIBRARY, linkedInto runc} with 'GPL-2.0-or-later' gives HOST_OS_SYSTEM_LIBRARY. The same glibc with 'LGPL-2.1-only' or 'GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1' also gives the class. {glibc, HOST_OS_LIBRARY} with 'GPL-2.0-or-later OR LGPL-2.1-only' gives ACCEPTED_OR, electing GPL-2.0-or-later. {libnftnl, HOST_OS_LIBRARY} with 'LGPL-2.1-or-later' gives the class. {libseccomp, STATIC, linkedInto containerd} and {libseccomp, STATIC, linkedInto pause} give the class. The libpathrs owner election applies when linked into containerd. The material case is the first: GPL-2.0-or-later was decided only for libnftnl, a host shared library loaded by the GPL program nft. Accepting it for a static library inside the Apache-2.0 binaries containerd, runc or pause would put GPL-2.0 code into those binaries without an owner decision. A host-image SBOM reporting such an expression would pass silently instead of reaching review. This is still broader than Q-L and Q-L2.
findings.requiredChange: Bind each class component to its decided expressions and, for a static library, to its decided binaries. Then pin both in the record and in check. Concretely: glibc gets LGPL-2.1-or-later, as HOST_OS_LIBRARY or as STATIC in containerd, pause and runc. libseccomp gets LGPL-2.1-only, as STATIC in runc only. libgcc and libgcc_eh get GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1, as STATIC in containerd, pause and runc. libnftnl gets GPL-2.0-or-later as HOST_OS_LIBRARY. libmnl gets LGPL-2.1-or-later as HOST_OS_LIBRARY. Bind the libpathrs election to runc. Add vectors that must come out OUT_OF_SCOPE: glibc static with GPL-2.0-or-later, glibc host with 'GPL-2.0-or-later OR LGPL-2.1-only', libnftnl with LGPL-2.1-or-later, and libseccomp linked into containerd or pause. The libpathrs election in containerd should fall back to ranking.

findings.finding: Non-blocking observations. (1) An approval accepts any subject in any of the decided kinds, so nft as HOST_OS_LIBRARY and libnftables as HOST_OS_PROGRAM are also approved. This is harmless. (2) Blocked outcomes return leaves [], so a consumer cannot see which term blocked; for example 'MIT AND GPL-2.0-only' for a crate gives OPTIONAL_EXPLICIT_REVIEW with no leaves. (3) Components are identified by bare names (glibc, gmp, nft, libgcc_eh, ...). SBOM generators report distro or package identities instead (for example libc6, libseccomp2, libgmp10, nftables, libnftables1). The host-image packet needs a reviewed mapping or a purl identity. Until then, mismatches fail closed (OUT_OF_SCOPE or OPTIONAL_EXPLICIT_REVIEW). (4) A forward risk for HE-001: planeon Rust modules built for *-linux-gnu link the GCC runtime and glibc. libgcc_s as HOST_OS_LIBRARY, and glibc or libgcc_eh linked into a planeon binary, now come out OUT_OF_SCOPE. That is correct under the decisions, but W03 will need either a musl or other build choice, or a further owner decision. (5) Accepting glibc as HOST_OS_LIBRARY relies on reading Q-L2's 'nft library closure' as including the host libc. That reading is reasonable, but the record does not state it. (6) HOST_OS_PROGRAM remains in the class allowedKinds although no class component uses it. (7) Text fields the classifier does not read still accept edits: neverFor, the class releaseOutcome, the releaseAdmission and rule texts, the owner summaries, and decision text fields with a recomputed digest. This is deferred to the packet authority's digest pin, per the L17(1) disposition. (8) For gmp only, a superset of a base review compound is accepted (round-2 L17(6)).

L11.reason: Each approval and owner election requires its subjects, its decided kinds and UPSTREAM_PINNED custody, and the kinds are inside the decision digest (recomputed independently, both match). Probes: nft as CRATE or PLANEON_SOURCE, libnftables static, gmp as CRATE, static, REPOSITORY_BUILT or HOST_OS_PROGRAM, nft as UPSTREAM_BINARY, and gmp's OR group for a gmp CRATE all give OPTIONAL_EXPLICIT_REVIEW. nft and libnftables as host program or library, and gmp as host library, stay approved. Mutations that change the kinds (even with a recomputed digest) or remove an election's kind are refused. The subject-by-kind cross product is noted in L19(1).

L12.reason: Option (i) is implemented. Only the six named components in their decided kinds qualify. A static library needs linkedInto one of containerd, pause or runc in UPSTREAM_PINNED custody, and validate_component enforces linkedInto if and only if the kind is STATIC. Probes: glibc linked into a planeon binary, into a repository-built runc or into kubelet; libgcc_eh in a planeon binary; unnamed libfoo; libseccomp as a host library; libmnl static; glibc as HOST_OS_PROGRAM: all give OUT_OF_SCOPE. Remaining gap: licenses and binaries are not bound per component (L18).
